Definition
[Ending lamination] 1. 9.3.6\group thurston.ch09.endingSource: thurston:page-0256 The ending lamination $\epsilon (E)$ of a geometrically infinite end $E$ is the union of all limits in $\mathcal{GL}(S)$ of sequences of closed geodesics exiting every compact subset of $E$.
